extraction.agency_name: Office of the Secretary of State
extraction.parent_department: Office of the Secretary of State

findings.title: Procedures and controls were not sufficient to ensure that charitable organizations complied with annual reporting requirements, that registrations were processed timely, and that critical data were accurately recorded.
findings.description: The Office lacked sufficient procedures and controls to ensure compliance with annual reporting requirements, timely processing of registrations, and accurate recording of information from charitable organizations. Testing revealed follow-up was not performed on 8 of 15 delinquent organizations, 5 exempt organizations did not meet exemption criteria based on contribution amounts, independent verifications were not performed leading to data discrepancies (e.g., $51,000 difference), and there was a backlog of 3,839 unprocessed forms.

dollar_amounts.context: minimum annual contributions reported by exempt organizations that did not qualify
maximum annual contributions reported by exempt organizations that did not qualify
annual contribution amount reported by one organization
amount recorded in Office's database for same organization
difference between reported and recorded amounts

findings.recommendation: Ensure timely follow-up is performed to obtain annual reports from delinquent organizations; ensure that organizations designated as exempt meet the required exemption criteria; perform independent verifications to ensure that information reported by charitable organizations is accurately recorded in the Office's database; and process applications on a timely basis.

findings.title: Adequate controls were not established over cash receipts.
findings.description: The Office had not established adequate controls over approximately $2.4 million in collections during fiscal year 2014. Checks were not restrictively endorsed immediately, stored in unlocked drawers, voided transactions lacked supervisory review by an independent employee, and collections were not verified to deposit by an independent employee. Credit card receipts totaling approximately $204,000 in fiscal year 2013 were not properly credited to the account.

dollar_amounts.context: credit card receipts during fiscal year 2013

findings.recommendation: Ensure that checks are restrictively endorsed immediately upon receipt and adequately safeguarded prior to deposit; ensure that a supervisory employee independent of the cash receipts process verifies the propriety of voided transactions; and ensure that an employee independent of the cash receipts function verifies that all collections, including credit card transactions, are subsequently deposited and credited to its account.

findings.title: Agreements were not prepared for funds provided to certain charitable organizations and accountings for the use of funds were not obtained.
findings.description: During June 2011 to April 2014, the Office made seven payments totaling $43,900 to two organizations without establishing required agreements or obtaining accountings of fund usage. While $10,000 was recorded as grant expenditures, the remaining amounts ($28,900 and $5,000) were classified as contractual services and materials/supplies, respectively, without proper reflection in State records regarding aid expenditure verification.

dollar_amounts.context: total payments made to two organizations
classified as materials and supplies expenditures

findings.recommendation: Establish required agreements with social organizations to which State support is provided and obtain reports required by such agreements to ensure that the aid provided is properly expended; verify that the $43,900 was properly expended; and ensure that such expenditures are properly recorded in its records.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The report states that the Office's response to findings and recommendations is included as an appendix, but specific details of the agency's agreement or completion dates are not provided in this text.
